title: SeqFold: Timestamp-Addressable Compressed States for User Action Sequence Backbones
abstract: arXiv:2611.13704v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing sequential user modeling methods mainly focus on improving the backbone encoder or learning task-specific user representations for a single prediction objective. We instead study how to export the multi-layer user states of a frozen long-history backbone as compact, timestamp-addressable representations for downstream training backfill and serving. In this setting, the user state at a given timestamp summarizes the user's actions before that time, so downstream systems need only the state aligned to each target timestamp rather than the full hidden-state timeline. To this end, we present \texttt{SeqFold}, a compressed-state interface that combines learned multi-channel fusion, channel-specific temporal decay, and Lookup-Free Quantization (LFQ) to produce compact discrete codes from frozen backbone states. Task-specific decoders then map these shared codes into flexible embedding spaces for downstream models. To make timestamp-ad

translated_title: SeqFold：面向用户行为序列骨干的时间戳可寻址压缩状态
translated_abstract: 现有的序列用户建模方法主要关注改进骨干编码器，或针对单一预测目标学习任务特定的用户表示。我们转而研究如何将冻结的长历史骨干网络的多层用户状态导出为紧凑的、时间戳可寻址的表示，用于下游训练回填与线上服务。在该设定下，给定时间戳的用户状态概括了用户在该时间点之前的行为，因此下游系统只需与每个目标时间戳对齐的状态，而无需完整的隐藏状态时间线。为此，我们提出SeqFold——一种压缩状态接口，它结合了可学习的多通道融合、通道特定的时间衰减以及无查找量化（LFQ），从冻结的骨干状态中生成紧凑的离散编码；随后由任务特定的解码器将这些共享编码映射到灵活的嵌入空间，供下游模型使用。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SeqFold通过可学习的多通道融合、通道级时间衰减与无查找量化（LFQ），将冻结长历史骨干网络的多层用户状态压缩为时间戳可寻址的紧凑离散编码，供下游任务直接对齐复用。
en_tdlr: SeqFold compresses frozen multi-layer user states from a long-history backbone into compact, timestamp-addressable discrete codes via learned multi-channel fusion, channel-specific temporal decay, and Lookup-Free Quantization for efficient downstream reuse.
